columns.name: Filing Due Date
columns.description: The filing due date for the information shown from the primary registration and/ or supplemental storefront registration.

columns.name: Reporting Year
columns.description: Year of the reporting period's end date on the primary registration and supplemental storefront registration.  For example; primary registrations whose reporting period that ended on December 31, 2019 and their corresponding supplemental storefront registration that ended the following year on June 30, 2020, would have ""2019 and 2020"" in this column.

columns.name: Borough Block Lot
columns.description: 10 digit Borough-Block-Lot of the property where the storefront is located

columns.name: Property Street Address or Storefront Address
columns.description: Reported street address for the storefront or the property address where the storefront is located

columns.name: Borough
columns.description: Borough where the storefront is located

columns.name: Zip Code
columns.description: ZIP code where the storefront is located

columns.name: Sold Date
columns.description: MM/DD/YYYY; Date property was reported sold if between 1/1 and 6/30, otherwise blank.

columns.name: Vacant on 12/31
columns.description: YES -  the storefront was reported vacant on 12/31 of the reporting year. NO - the storefront was reported owner-occupied or leased on 12/31 of the reporting year.

columns.name: Construction Reported
columns.description: YES - construction is reported in the storefront as of 12/31.

columns.name: Vacant 6/30 or Date Sold
columns.description: For Classes 2 and 4: YES -  following 12/31 of the reporting year, the storefront was reported vacant on 6/30 or the date the property was sold if earlier than 6/30.  Blank means there is no reported information.

columns.name: Primary Business Activity
columns.description: For Classes 2 and 4: Local Law 157 requires owners to submit a supplemental registration to report any property ownership changes or storefronts that become vacant between 1/1 and 6/30 after the reporting year, and for the Department of Finance to identify storefronts reported vacant as of 6/30.  Some property owners who did not submit main registrations or submitted main registrations with missing information used the supplemental registration to provide information on the vacancy status of storefronts for both 12/31 and 6/30.    For Class 1: Registered class 1 storefronts were not required to update their status as of 6/30 or date sold if earlier than 6/30.

columns.name: Expiration date of the most recent lease
columns.description: The expiration date of the most recent lease for vacant premises, as reported by owner.

columns.name: Property Number
columns.description: Address number for the building.

columns.name: Property Street
columns.description: Street name or number for the building.

columns.name: Unit
columns.description: Unit number for the property.

columns.name: Borough1
columns.description: ZIP Code for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: Postcode
columns.description: ZIP Code for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Latitude

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Longitude

columns.name: Lat/Long
columns.description: Combined Latitude and Longitude

columns.name: Community Board
columns.description: Community board for the building where the storefront is located and designated within borough.

columns.name: Council District
columns.description: Council district for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: Census Tract
columns.description: Census tract designated within the borough for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: BIN
columns.description: Building Identification Number (BIN) for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: BBL
columns.description: BBL (Borough, Block and Lot) for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: NTA
columns.description: Neighborhood Tabulation Area (NTA) code for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: NTA Neighborhood
columns.description: Neighborhood name associated with Neighborhood Tabulation Area (NTA) for the building where the storefront is located.

columns.name: Community Districts
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Districts' (f5dn-yrer) the point in column 'lat_long' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
